entries.title: Psalms 145:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of praise. Of David.>> I will extol thee, my God, O King, and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.

entries.title: Psalms 145:2
segments: Every day will I bless thee, and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.

entries.title: Psalms 145:3
segments: Great is Jehovah, and exceedingly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.

entries.title: Psalms 145:4
segments: One generation shall laud thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.

entries.title: Psalms 145:5
segments: I will speak of the glorious splendour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.

entries.title: Psalms 145:6
segments: And they shall tell of the might of thy terrible acts; and thy great deeds will I declare.

entries.title: Psalms 145:7
segments: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 145:8
segments: Jehovah is gracious and merciful; slow to anger, and of great loving-kindness.

entries.title: Psalms 145:9
segments: Jehovah is good to all; and his tender mercies are over all his works.

entries.title: Psalms 145:10
segments: ¶All thy works shall praise thee, Jehovah, and thy saints shall bless thee.

entries.title: Psalms 145:11
segments: They shall tell of the glory of thy kingdom, and speak of thy power;

entries.title: Psalms 145:12
segments: To make known to the children of men his mighty acts, and the glorious splendour of his kingdom.

entries.title: Psalms 145:13
segments: Thy kingdom is a kingdom of all ages, and thy dominion is throughout all generations.

entries.title: Psalms 145:14
segments: Jehovah upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all that are bowed down.

entries.title: Psalms 145:15
segments: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their food in its season.

entries.title: Psalms 145:16
segments: Thou openest thy hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.

entries.title: Psalms 145:17
segments: Jehovah is righteous in all his ways, and kind in all his works.

entries.title: Psalms 145:18
segments: Jehovah is nigh unto all that call upon him, unto all that call upon him in truth.

entries.title: Psalms 145:19
segments: He fulfilleth the desire of them that fear him; he heareth their cry, and saveth them.

entries.title: Psalms 145:20
segments: Jehovah keepeth all that love him, and all the wicked will he destroy.

entries.title: Psalms 145:21
segments: My mouth shall speak the praise of Jehovah; and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
